analogy.rationale: Aurora kinases are mitotic regulators; their inhibition causes mitotic arrest and a transcriptional program shared with other mitotic-arresting agents such as PLK, CDK, microtubule, and tubulin inhibitors. Kinesin inhibitors also perturb mitosis but with lower transcriptional overlap.
